_doc: the-unwilling-agentic-bunch — the agent layer's OWN project.config.json. The repo is its own first consumer: standalone CI runs the framework's gates on the framework itself with PROJECT_ROOT=$AGENT_LAYER_ROOT. This file is the reference example for a NO-PRODUCT-CODE consumer; a consumer with product code additionally fills `build` and `perf` and drops `profile` (or sets it to "product"). || SCHEMA: no project.config.schema.json ships beside this file, so project-config.sh's no-deps required-key gate is inert here by construction (it catches FileNotFoundError and passes). That is NOT the layer's escape hatch — schema validation for this file is a HOST-side responsibility, run in the host's doc-validation.yml and agent-layer-integration.yml, the only lanes where both trees coexist. Do not set PC_SCHEMA_FILE here. || project.literals DELIBERATELY OMITS the host product name. test-portable-purity.sh reads exactly this list as its denylist; seeding it with the host's literals would fail the layer's own purity gate on prose that has not been de-Smatchet-ified yet, which is an explicit plan non-goal. This is a DEFERRAL, NOT AN EXEMPTION: with the host name off this denylist the layer-side gate can never see residual host literals in public prose, so the compensating check lives host-side in agent-layer-integration.yml (plan row 12b) — the only lane with both trees checked out — re-running the same scan over agent-layer/'s tracked files against the HOST's project.literals, WARN-only against a committed layer-side baseline that ratchets down. Until row 12b lands, the hole is open and tracked. || lint.zones are scoped to the moved tree: no product source exists here, so the strict zone is the gate scripts and the light zone is the prose surface. || merge_gates.override_labels deliberately omits plan-lock-out-of-band: there is no docs/plans/ in the layer, so there is no plan-lock gate to override.

branch_protection._doc: required_contexts must name EXACTLY the job names the row-9 lanes emit UNCONDITIONALLY. test-required-context-parity.sh asserts that; a context named here that a lane emits behind an `if:` wedges every layer PR forever.

agents._doc: enabled_project is empty: agents/project/** is project-scoped by construction and is NOT seeded into the public layer (seed-paths.txt enumerates the four portable subtrees rather than a bare agents/ prefix, precisely so agents/project/ cannot ride along).
